_README: Real work photos. To add one: put the file in /assets/images/work/ (WebP preferred, about 1200px wide), then fill in 'src', 'width', 'height' and a description in 'alt'. While 'src' is empty a clearly labelled placeholder is shown. Only use photos of your own work. Optional 'avif' gives an even smaller file for browsers that support it.
